bsi.editorial_reason: Gadara (Umm Qais) and Gerasa (Jerash) are historically distinct Decapolis cities, not equivalent name forms. The source's Gadara.primary_id=place:Gerasa falsely merges their identities. Preserve ALL exact original Greek demonym word groups and verse references as candidates, including cross-gospel textual variants; a demonym is not proof of the precise miracle site. Gadara.2 (Perea) remains separate.
